definition.phi: SiLU(frozen Linear(4,8)) after frozen last4 source standardization
definition.fit_rows: all auxiliary-active months at explicit source stations; no DOC label/mask filter
definition.fit_center: each source station's active-month phi mean
definition.projection_center: one pooled source-global active phi mean; no target centering
definition.whitening: sqrt(max(eigenvalue,eigenvalue_floor)); components at/below floor are zero
definition.eigen_sign: largest absolute loading positive; first index breaks a loading tie
definition.absent_auxiliary: chemical coordinates zero; legacy coordinates unchanged
definition.centering_gauges: within-source covariance and source-global projection are intentionally distinct
